name: terracognita
description: Reads from existing Cloud Providers and generates Terraform code

repo.name: terracognita
repo.description: Reads from existing public and private cloud providers (reverse Terraform) and generates your infrastructure as code on Terraform configuration

readme.summary: Well-structured README with excellent installation instructions and clear project purpose, but lacking concrete usage examples and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: Missing concrete end-to-end examples showing actual commands with real flags for different cloud providers - the usage section is too abstract and the asciinema video link doesn't substitute for written examples.

injection_risks.description: The 'goimports' command is executed with user-controlled input, which may lead to code injection vulnerabilities.
The 'decodeDynamicValue' function uses the 'msgpack.Unmarshal' and 'ctyjson.Unmarshal' functions with user-controlled input, which may lead to deserialization vulnerabilities.

critical_findings: Potential code injection vulnerability in aws/cmd/main.go
security.summary: The terracognita package has several security concerns, including potential code injection and deserialization vulnerabilities, as well as input validation issues and error exposure risks.

common_complaints: Non-deterministic output (same command produces different results)
AWS region-specific failures (500 errors in certain regions like ca-central-1)
Dependency/cycle errors in generated Terraform configurations
Limited resource type support (missing aws_ecr_repository, aws_kms_key, aws_eks_addon)
vsphere import failures with templates and unsupported disk types
Lack of credential chain support (AWS SDK default chain)
sentiment.summary: Terracognita shows signs of abandonment with zero maintainer engagement, accumulating unfixed bugs spanning 2+ years, critical reproducibility issues, and unresponded feature requests indicating a stalled project.

red_flags: Occasional use of technical jargon without sufficient context
communication.summary: The maintainer provides detailed and helpful responses, though there are occasional instances where clarity could be improved for less technically-savvy users.

concerns: No commits in the past 6 months despite being last updated September 2025
93 open issues with no recent activity or closure
Zero closed issues in the past 6 months indicating no maintenance
No active contributors in the past 6 months
No merged pull requests in the past 6 months
No open PRs suggesting lack of ongoing development
maintenance.summary: The terracognita package appears to be abandoned with no maintenance activity, issue resolution, or development over the past 6 months despite having a significant backlog of 93 open issues.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-categorized and appears comprehensive, but lacks clear marking of breaking changes and migration guides.

governance.summary: The project lacks a documented succession plan and contributor ladder, which increases the risk if key maintainers leave.
